purpose: Keep app-open queue/status state available while a readiness callback verifies the UI process and image.

baseline.path: acceptAppOpen -> UIReady -> residentagent.uiReadySince -> launchrecord.UIProcessMatches -> Inspect -> openExecutable/digest. The full image hash, bounded at 64 MiB, ran while appOpen.mu was held.
baseline.reproduction: FAIL: while the readiness callback was blocked, an unrelated QueueAppOpen followed by AppOpenStatus failed to return during the full 1-second observation. The fixture released and joined both calls afterward.

change.lockScope: Run readiness and post-I/O authorization callbacks outside appOpen.mu; restore the caller's lock before checking and committing the receipt. This removes image-size-dependent O(B) I/O from this readiness critical section; state operations remain O(1). Full image verification itself remains O(B).
change.capacity: A separate TryLock gate permits at most one readiness callback per Manager. Contending polls return their observed launch_requested receipt instead of queuing behind image I/O. No detached worker, hash cache or additional native permission is introduced.
change.publication: Recheck trust, receipt ID, request timestamp, the 2-minute retention limit and current status after I/O. A replacement/expired request or terminal status cannot be overwritten by an older successful check.
change.interfaces: No HTTP route, JSON schema, DB, installer, repository hygiene, task runner or source-of-truth document changes.

validation.focused: PASS: TestAppOpen suite, 0.113s. Queue/status return while readiness is blocked; concurrent checks retain one I/O owner; a later poll obtains a fresh verification; replacement, expiry, revocation and terminal-result cases prevent stale publication. Existing deduplication, authorization, window-readiness and timeout tests pass. Test timings include fixtures and are not physical-PC performance measurements.
validation.packages: PASS: go test -timeout 3m ./internal/peerupdate ./internal/residentagent, 10.513s and 6.529s, with Go 1.27.3 and the repository runtime STW overlay.
validation.hygiene: PASS: changed Go files formatted with gofmt; git diff --check.
validation.skipped: Full repository, frontend, installer/release packaging and physical two-PC acceptance: only internal app-open readiness lock scope changed, with no installed program update.

remainingRisk: The callback already owning readiness can still wait on native/filesystem I/O. This change keeps shared app-open state available and bounds concurrent verification; it does not preempt that I/O or prove that input-service error 1066 or cursor handoff stutter is resolved.
